suggested_queries.rationale: Search the target’s official KIND and DART contract-disclosure class, which is distinct from the 36 executed earnings, IR, fair-disclosure, and broker queries. A filing available by 2026-07-12 could identify an actual HBM or memory supply contract, period, amount, counterparty treatment, or termination terms relevant to DURABLE_VISIBILITY. Do not infer that a filing or binding contract exists, and do not substitute customer discussions or broker estimates.

unresolved_research_notes: The existing 36 queries cover earnings calls, IR, fair disclosures, customer-official routes, sustainability material, registration statements, and broker PDFs, but they do not explicitly test the formal KIND/DART supply-contract disclosure class.

If the official contract-disclosure search returns no target filing, DURABLE_VISIBILITY remains unresolved: absence of a public filing does not prove either that no agreement exists or that customer demand discussions are binding, non-cancellable purchase obligations.

FORWARD_GUIDANCE and SEGMENT_CONTRIBUTION still require issuer-sourced machine-numeric evidence; a contract disclosure without eligible numeric forward guidance or segment value cannot close those separate roles.
